_about: teach what metals do, the herbal manuals' counterpart (content/rules/herbal-manuals.json,
0.2.4). Reading one takes hours of world time and teaches the properties it lists; the
bench pays its mastery once (smithing-lore.json `manual`). Read by rules/knowledge.py;
Original writing for Pathfinder GM (2026-10-03). Prices in gold, in the herbal manuals'
range, the deep-metals book dearer as the beast-parts book is.
`teaches` names metals by material id and says which of each one's properties the book
holds: "all", "benefits", "drawbacks", "working" (the working traits only), or a
list of property keys ("w0", "a1", "t0"...). The words are preferred over keys: keys
are positions in a material's lists, and the data pass can move them. An id the
materials do not hold is skipped, never invented. Metals are named by id only, so the
skymetal names' licensing call (plan §15.2) can rename them without touching this file.
